definition: two parallel rails used in gymnastics
description: On a wide, flat, white salt plain at sunrise under a pale pink sky, a young man in a white sleeveless top, navy trousers and white socks pushes up into a perfectly straight handstand on a simple wooden set of two parallel bars, his arms locked and his legs pointing to the sky. Then he swings off the bars sideways, lands on the cracked salt ground in a cloud of white dust and throws both arms up in triumph.
